atoms.statement: Runtime V2 is the active implementation direction; V1 monolith is reference/rollback only.
Product completion must be separated from code/CI/docs and reusable asset maturity.
Seek Again recovery follows FINAL SEEK failure and same-day recovery is not spaced recovery.
Trail Mastery is current session/mission readiness; Memory Strength is long-term memory evidence.
Ready owns review policy and Planner schedule; Hide owns evidence/advisory signals only.
OCR partial success is preserved and only failed pages are retried.
390x844 browser layout, reduced-height focus, offline shell and PWA safe-point flows have browser evidence; device verification remains zero.
Frozen candidate 02 is the current governed frozen candidate; candidate 01 is superseded.
Netlify deploy action cannot specify exact source ref; do not consume one-deploy budget.
Continue child-facing UI/UX surgery against Hide_Seek_UI_MASTER_LOGIC_REV_04 after restoring exact-head CI.
Representative real-provider OCR, physical device camera/keyboard/PWA lifecycle, and live hosted Ready-Hide roundtrip remain open.
Locked last closed product estimate: Product 78, Coded 94, CI 91, Browser Runtime 87, Device 0, Release 0.
Runtime V2 Hanja SOUND FIND has dedicated browser proof using verified source-linked soundEvidence; typed SOUND recall is objective recall and preserves sourceRef.
Runtime V2 Korean verified EVIDENCE TRAIL is browser-verified: explicit verified context evidence selection earns EVIDENCE+MEANING objective verification without claiming CONTEXT recall.
Korean context exposure or evidence selection must not be converted into objective CONTEXT recall; RESPONSE TRAIL remains production evidence.
Browser exploration art-direction continuity is verified across child-facing surfaces; physical-device visual QA remains open.
A correct FINAL SEEK answer after explicit support is assisted and must not count as objective recall; same-day unassisted Seek Again recovery remains IMMEDIATE_ONLY until spaced evidence exists.
OCR review-to-mission commit preserves nested OCR page/row/confidence/provider/model/analysisVersion provenance.
Duplicate OCR lexical rows are merged only by explicit review action; the resulting mission item preserves every source occurrence under source.occurrences.
OCR local-first review continuity persists human corrections, exclusions and explicit duplicate-merge decisions separately from raw OCR lastRows; reload/resume restores reviewDraft.
FIRST FIND wrong recall enters an explicit relearn exposure before MEANING; answer re-exposure is assisted RELEARN_EXPOSURE and never objective recall.
FIRST FIND supports explicit UNSURE as PASS retrieval evidence with objectiveRecall=true and objectiveVerified=false; wrong/unsure both enter assisted non-recall relearn exposure before MEANING.
HIDDEN WORDS reinforcement is conditionally activated from the V2 Memory Engine primaryReason; stable items bypass it and reinforcement relearn remains assisted non-recall exposure.
Normal MEMORIZE/relearn exposure marked assisted must not be counted as hint dependency; hintDependency derives only from actual ASSISTANCE or positive hintLevel evidence.
HIDDEN WORDS maps Memory Engine primaryReason to bounded activity modes: confusion->meaning, orthographic->English shape scaffold, verified sound->sound recall, otherwise unassisted token recall.
MEANING CLUE uses session-scoped bidirectional recognition when valid peers exist; peerless sessions retain direct typed meaning recall.
MEANING recognition peers must come only from the active session.queue so Ready-directed lexical-id scope is not broadened by unrelated mission items.
MEANING recognition MISMATCH stores the confused token/meaning pair as objective recognition evidence without claiming recall, feeding Memory Engine confusion and Hidden Words meaning reinforcement.
HIDDEN WORDS uses bounded staged assistance: reinforcement miss -> one safe minimal clue when available -> assisted retry -> full relearn only if still needed -> FINAL SEEK unassisted verification.
HIDDEN WORDS SHAPE mode displays a form cue and therefore must record assisted non-recall evidence; direct typed MEANING reinforcement remains objective meaning recall.

Safe Hidden Words clue escalation is narrow: TOKEN may use English shape scaffold and MEANING may use existing example/context; unsupported SOUND/SHAPE second clues fail closed to relearn instead of inventing evidence.
FINAL SEEK keeps the first attempt unassisted; an unassisted English miss may use one shape-based assisted reconstruction before any full relearn exposure.
A correct FINAL_SEEK_RECONSTRUCT result is assisted and objectively verifiable but not objective recall; SEEK AGAIN remains the unassisted proof.
Do not stack shape reconstruction after semantic FINAL SEEK support; if support was already used, fail closed to relearn before SEEK AGAIN.
Wrong Hanja SOUND FIND now records objective sound recall failure, then uses verified source-linked reading relearn exposure before SOUND-specific Hidden Words reinforcement.
Verified sound relearn exposure is assisted/non-recall and must not be counted as SOUND recall success.

Immediate Hanja sound recovery may carry a session-scoped activity override so a concrete phonological weakness is not masked by generic recovery; this does not alter Memory Engine scores or Ready review/scheduling ownership.
Runtime V2 MEMORIZE records first-seen prediction, clue used and confidence before reveal, then learner MATCH/NEAR/MISS comparison after reveal.
Inference outcome remains LEARNER_SELF_REPORT with objectiveVerified=false, objectiveRecall=false and no recall-score impact; it must not inflate memory strength.
Only ESTABLISHED and current-plan-applicable inference clue tendencies may surface as optional later guidance; LOW/EMERGING evidence must not become stable personalization.
English FIRST FIND wrong/UNSURE may use one safe shape cue before full relearn; assisted retry is objectively checkable but never objective recall.
A correct FIRST_FIND_ASSIST response must not be counted as unassisted recall or Memory Strength recall success.
FIRST FIND assistance fails closed outside supported English shape cues; Korean/Hanja cues must not be fabricated.
